chi.observed_sign_convention: chi > 0 corresponds to BS-3 truth_sign +1 (direct convention)

interface_mismatches.interface: HC-1H session persistence before first label
interface_mismatches.mismatch: Constructing CheckerApplication returns an ACTIVE blinded state but does not persist answers.jsonl/SESSION_STARTED until the first checker event.
interface_mismatches.real_run_implication: If pre-label durable session creation is required for operational custody, add a dedicated start-session event/entry point before the real run.
interface_mismatches.workaround: Verified the ACTIVE zero-completed state, package, control binding, commitment, and sealed envelope without manufacturing a C/W answer; reported the absence of a durable session ledger explicitly.

interface_mismatches.interface: Natural BS-3 population versus HC-1H floor
interface_mismatches.mismatch: The first unselected N=2,000 draw produced populations 28, 8, and 11 in three cells, so the frozen floor of 30 made full preparation impossible.
interface_mismatches.real_run_implication: The real accepted population cannot be engineered this way; if any real cell has N_s<30, HC-1H is infeasible and must hold or receive a preregistered sparse-cell rule before any labels.
interface_mismatches.workaround: Preserved that failed attempt, screened 12,000 deterministic BS-3 candidates synthetically, and selected an exactly 2,000-object campaign with 667/667/666 objects across global |chi| thirds and at least 35 of every committee state per third (floor 30 plus HC-7 reserve headroom); then reran the selected campaign through inference and committee.

interface_mismatches.mismatch: The frozen torch venv lacked Pillow, cryptography, and astropy, while the system Python had those packages but lacked torch.
interface_mismatches.real_run_implication: The production command needs one hash-locked environment containing every gated program's dependencies.
interface_mismatches.workaround: Ran the torch venv interpreter with the existing user-site package directory on PYTHONPATH; no install and no network.

interface_mismatches.mismatch: The runner accepts every tensor as a separate --inputs argument and has no manifest/stdin mode; 2,000 absolute paths risk the macOS argument-length ceiling and the real campaign would certainly exceed it.
interface_mismatches.real_run_implication: Add a hash-bound manifest input mode before the real campaign without changing inference semantics.
interface_mismatches.workaround: Called the unmodified gated run_paths API with the complete ordered Path list.

interface_mismatches.mismatch: committee.py has no campaign CLI and does not itself load its frozen member-B weights.
interface_mismatches.real_run_implication: Provide a gated batch entry point or formally designate inference receipts as the committee campaign product.
interface_mismatches.workaround: Loaded its hash-pinned SmallPlainCNN weights and called its unmodified scoring/state functions in a separate post-inference pass, then cross-checked every state against inference metadata.

interface_mismatches.mismatch: Inference consumes raw 65,536-byte float32 tensors, but HC-1H requires Pillow-readable image_path assets and cannot ingest those tensors.
interface_mismatches.real_run_implication: Freeze the real tensor-to-checker rendering map and bind each PNG to its source tensor hash before the real hand-check.
interface_mismatches.workaround: Created deterministic 128x128 grayscale PNG sidecars from each exact tensor using fixed percentile display scaling; tensor inference bytes remained untouched.

interface_mismatches.interface: Neyman priors at perfect/near-perfect synthetic recovery
interface_mismatches.mismatch: The HC-1H allocator refuses when every empirical prior is exactly 0 or 1 because all information weights become zero; finite synthetic strata can hit that boundary.
interface_mismatches.real_run_implication: Freeze the prior estimator/smoothing rule before production rather than selecting it after seeing synthetic outcomes.
interface_mismatches.workaround: Used an explicit Jeffreys-smoothed synthetic estimate (correct+0.5)/(N_s+1), then passed it to the unmodified constrained allocator.

interface_mismatches.mismatch: The committee emits uppercase underscore states, while HC-1H accepts lowercase hyphenated states only.
interface_mismatches.real_run_implication: Freeze one canonical vocabulary or a hash-pinned adapter.
interface_mismatches.workaround: Applied the explicit bijection AGREE_CONFIDENT→agree-confident, DISAGREE→disagree, LOW_CONFIDENCE→low-confidence.

interface_mismatches.mismatch: The harness calls its 500-row input real_population even when data_class is synthetic, and separately requires another synthetic_pool for injections.
interface_mismatches.real_run_implication: Production must supply genuinely separate accepted real population and blind-injection pool, with identity-disjointness policy made explicit.
interface_mismatches.workaround: Used the 2,000-object synthetic campaign as a synthetic-class accepted population and a separately identified view of the same generated assets as an injection pool; no claim of independent science samples is made.
